byte_interpretation.validity: MUST reject invalid UTF-8 before the first operation and after every operation; NEVER replace malformed bytes

limits.enforcement: MUST reject more than max_operations before execution or commitment reconstruction; MUST charge every operation input and every repeated internal decode pass against max_cumulative_processed_bytes before processing it; MUST reject an input exceeding max_input_bytes before applying a recipe and an intermediate or final output exceeding max_output_bytes after every operation

control_character_policy.rule: MUST reject a Unicode control character in either field before evaluating the operation

url_component_policy.input: MUST be an absolute URL with a non-empty scheme and host
url_component_policy.hostname: returns the URL hostname without a port
url_component_policy.raw_query: returns the URL raw query bytes without the leading question mark
url_component_policy.query_key_and_query_value: parse the raw query with application/x-www-form-urlencoded semantics; malformed query escaping is an error; selector identifies a key; occurrence is zero-based among values for that key; a missing key or occurrence is an error

percent_decode.algorithm: RFC 3986 percent decoding of path-escaped bytes; plus is not decoded as space
percent_decode.canonicality: input need not be canonical, but malformed escapes are errors

hex_decode.canonicality: decode then lowercase-hex re-encode; the result MUST equal the input exactly

base32_decode.canonicality: decode then re-encode in the selected padding mode; the result MUST equal the input exactly

base64_decode.alphabet: RFC 4648 standard base64 alphabet; URL-safe alphabet is forbidden
base64_decode.canonicality: decode then re-encode in the selected padding mode; the result MUST equal the input exactly

query_unescape.algorithm: application/x-www-form-urlencoded query decoding; plus decodes to ASCII space
query_unescape.passes: repeat until unchanged, malformed input, or scanner_query_unescape_max_rounds; malformed input returns the last successfully decoded value

liberal_decoders.hex: Go encoding/hex DecodeString semantics without a canonical re-encoding check
liberal_decoders.base32: RFC 4648 standard base32 selected by decode_padding, without a canonical re-encoding check
liberal_decoders.base64: RFC 4648 standard or URL-safe base64 selected by alphabet and decode_padding, without a canonical re-encoding check

normalization.invisible_strip: remove C0 controls except TAB, LF, and CR; remove DEL, C1 controls, U+00AD, U+115F-U+1160, U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+2069, U+3164, U+FE00-U+FE0F, U+FEFF, U+FFF9-U+FFFB, U+E0000-U+E007F, and U+E0100-U+E01EF
normalization.invisible_space: replace the invisible_strip character set with ASCII space instead of removing it; preserve TAB, LF, and CR
normalization.matching_normalize: apply invisible_strip, Unicode NFKC, dlp_normalize.confusable_to_ascii, Unicode NFD combining-mark removal, then replace only U+00A0, U+1680, U+180E, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028-U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, and U+3000 with ASCII space; preserve existing ASCII whitespace, including leading and repeated whitespace
normalization.encoded_token_normalize: apply the scanner's alphabet-specific delimiter removal for hex, base32, standard base64, or URL-safe base64; return the empty string when the token is ineligible
normalization.text_segment: split with the scanner text-DLP delimiter set and select the zero-based non-empty occurrence
normalization.html_entity_decode: apply HTML5 entity decoding until unchanged or html_entity_decode_max_passes
normalization.url_noise_strip: remove dot, slash, ASCII space/TAB/LF/CR, plus, comma, semicolon, and vertical bar
normalization.ordered_query_concat: split a raw query on ampersand, take each non-empty post-equals value in wire order, query_unescape it, and concatenate
normalization.query_subsequence: from the first query_subsequence_max_values non-empty raw-query values in wire order, query_unescape each and concatenate the strictly increasing zero-based indices
normalization.encoded_run: select a zero-based scanner base64/hex-alphabet run meeting minimum_length, reattaching at most two immediately trailing equals signs
normalization.canary_canonicalize: remove dot, slash, backslash, question mark, ampersand, equals, ASCII space/TAB/LF/CR, colon, semicolon, comma, hyphen, underscore, at sign, percent, plus, and hash

pipeline: remove C0, C1, DEL, and the invisible_strip Unicode ranges
Unicode NFD then remove all Mn code points

recipe_execution: Apply operation_vocabulary in listed order only as selected by the ordered recipe. An unknown operation, unknown field, forbidden field, missing required field, malformed input, or canonicality failure MUST reject the recipe; no operation may preserve, skip, or substitute undecodable input.
